svg.title: Two grants let you and the coding agent co-write one tree
svg.desc: A claim writes two grants on the project. The coding agent's group grant reaches the files you write, whatever your umask; your named grant reaches the files the coding agent writes, before the handback makes you their owner. Neither of you joins the other's group, others get no access, and every new file inherits both grants.
